svg.title: Open-Codemap
svg.desc: LIBRARY + CLI · TYPESCRIPT · MIT. A local-first codebase indexer for AI agents. It gives a model the exact functions it needs and how they connect, instead of whole files. Pipeline: tree-sitter parsing, structural chunks, embeddings, call and import graph.
